source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: When rolling to charge with a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit, you can re-roll. Favoured Ka'tah: Dacatarai. When you select the Dacatarai ka’tah ability of Martial Ka'tah for a readied unit, it also gains an extra effect for the rest of that phase: whenever an enemy unit that is engaged with it makes a pile-in or consolidation move, that move is 2″ shorter.

additionalEffect.trigger: engaged enemy unit's pile-in or consolidation move
additionalEffect.durationBasis: Core Rules 01.02.02: an effect with no stated duration lasts only for the phase in which it was applied.
